|descr= {{Feature|warning|This function is broken (at least in {{arma3}}) as it has a typo, displaying an error on each use!  (typo '''line 63''', {{hl|[centrum]}} instead of {{hl|[_centrum]}}).}}
This function gets objects (but centre object) positions and direction relative to the choosen object and copies the result to the clipboard via [[copyToClipboard]].<br>
Result is to format:
<sqf>[
	// 11 elements for one object
	_nameOfObject, _objectClass, _objectToGet, _computedAngle, _distance, _newDir, _vectorUp, _vectorDir, _animation, _elevASL, _elev,
	_nameOfObject, _objectClass, _objectToGet, _computedAngle, _distance, _newDir, _vectorUp, _vectorDir, _animation, _elevASL, _elev,
	// ...
]</sqf>
{{Feature|important|Please note that the clipboard result is a one-level array, meaning that all parameters are defined one after the other!}}

|s1= [centre, radius, type] call [[BIS_fnc_sceneGetObjects]]

|p1= centre: [[Object]] or [[String]] - object or marker name - '''NOT''' a [[Position]]

|p2= radius: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 20)

|p3= type: [[String]] - (Optional, default "All") - objects type (see [[nearestObjects]])

|r1= [[Script Handle]]

|x1= <sqf>[player, 20, "Car"] call BIS_fnc_sceneGetObjects;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_sceneSetObjects]] [[BIS_fnc_objectsGrabber]] [[BIS_fnc_objectsMapper]]
}}
